text:
- **Sprint proposals:** Agents can now propose sprints for what the repository needs, and the owner accepts or dismisses each one. Repository feedback was dropped, so proposals are now the only way to suggest repository changes.
- **Search ranking:** Search ranks records and items together and shows each hit at its best match. The new model passed the baseline gate but did not beat the rg or newest-first orders.
- **Site and overview:** The overview lists open projects first and folds closed projects into a collapsed section. The site can now serve a network without Cloudflare, with separate reach, address, and access settings.
- **Project tools:** pm can now review pull requests in other GitHub repositories and store their merges. Projects can be renamed, and checks flag title drift.
